novelty_basis: Proposition 3 of the ETP write-up 'Spectra of order-3 equations' (Lean Zulip upload; attributed in Le Floch's notes to Ben Gunby-Mann) gives the same orbit argument and the full spectrum. Our addition is a Lean formalisation of the necessity half via a fixed-point-free involution on Sym2.
proof_check: Lean 4 + Mathlib (Infinity.C05.law167_card_mod_four; standard axioms only); models of orders 4 and 5 certified by decide
statement:
If a finite magma satisfies x = (y*x)*(x*y) for all x, y, its order n satisfies n = 0 or 1 (mod 4).
(With the constructions of the ETP write-up "Spectra of order-3 equations" the spectrum is exactly
{n : n = 0, 1 mod 4}.)
title: Law 167, x = (y*x)*(x*y): every finite model has order 0 or 1 mod 4
